chain.label: FAA exemption of commercial balloon pilots from medical certificate requirements
chain.trigger: 14 CFR 61.23(b) exempts balloon pilots from all medical certificate requirements

chain.label: Pilot's undetected/uncontrolled depression, ADHD, and multiple CNS-impairing medications
chain.trigger: the pilot had been diagnosed with medical conditions, including depression and attention deficit hyperactivity disorder, known to cause cognitive deficits

caused_by.evidence: the FAA's exemption of balloon pilots from medical certification requirements eliminated the potential opportunity for an AME to identify the pilot's potentially impairing medical conditions and medications

chain.label: Pilot failed to obtain updated weather information before launch
chain.trigger: The pilot did not seek additional weather information after receiving the FSS weather briefing and before launch

caused_by.evidence: depression, ADHD, and the combined effects of multiple CNS-impairing drugs likely affected the pilot's ability to make safe decisions

chain.label: Pilot decided to launch despite indicators (fog seen, 1°C temp/dew point spread) that conditions were deteriorating
chain.trigger: The pilot made the final decision to launch at Fentress Airpark

caused_by.evidence: the pilot's failure to obtain updated weather information denied him information that indicated conditions were deteriorating and might not remain VFR, which resulted in his decision to launch when he should have cancelled
depression, ADHD, and the combined effects of multiple CNS-impairing drugs likely affected the pilot's ability to make safe decisions

chain.label: Balloon encountered fog and low clouds along the flight route shortly after launch
chain.trigger: Fog and low clouds were visible from the balloon along the flight route within minutes of launch

caused_by.evidence: the balloon launched about 0658... a passenger photograph taken 2 minutes after launch... showed low clouds and fog

chain.label: Pilot's pattern of continuing flight in and out of clouds, climbing above an overcast layer, and descending near/through clouds that obscured obstacles
chain.trigger: the pilot exhibited poor decision-making (1) when he did not land the balloon despite having had suitable opportunities to land safely in visual conditions and (2) when he decided to climb above the clouds

caused_by.evidence: instead of selecting a suitable landing location while still in visual contact with the ground, the pilot continued the flight, flying in and out of clouds and decreased visibility conditions until climbing above the clouds
depression, ADHD, and the combined effects of multiple CNS-impairing drugs likely affected the pilot's ability to make safe decisions

chain.label: Balloon struck high-voltage power lines while descending through/near clouds
chain.trigger: struck power lines and crashed in a field near Lockhart, Texas

caused_by.evidence: the pilot's decision to land in reduced visibility conditions that diminished his ability to see and avoid obstacles resulted in the balloon impacting power lines that were obscured by low clouds and/or fog

chain.label: Basket separated from envelope/burner assembly and fell to the ground; fuel released and fire ensued
chain.trigger: The basket fell about 100 ft to the ground after separation from the envelope and burner assembly

caused_by.evidence: the balloon's support cables struck power lines, causing separation of the basket from the envelope and burner assembly, the release of fuel, and the subsequent fire and ground impact

chain.label: Pilot and all 15 passengers killed by impact forces and postcrash fire
chain.trigger: The pilot and 15 passengers died, and the balloon was destroyed by impact forces and postcrash fire

caused_by.evidence: Autopsy results indicated the causes of death for the occupants included various combinations of blunt force trauma, thermal burns, and inhalation injuries
